description: Alert: see $defs/Alert. A safety alert raised by the deterministic rules engine before any urgency suggestion. No model can lower or remove it. There is no free-text message: display_text comes from a fixed per-rule template (packages/contracts/alert_templates.yaml).

RuleId.description: The safety rule that raised the alert.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: A safety alert raised by the deterministic rules engine before any urgency suggestion. No model can lower or remove it. There is no free-text message: display_text comes from a fixed per-rule template (packages/contracts/alert_templates.yaml).

ruleset_version.description: Semantic version of the ruleset that raised the alert.

evidence_fact_ids.description: The facts that triggered the rule. Never empty.

required_action.description: Message key for the action the nurse must take, e.g. ecg_within_10_min.

display_text.description: Short non-PHI line rendered from the fixed template for rule_id (plus fixed qualifiers). Never patient words.

partial.description: True when the rule fired on incomplete inputs (e.g. a partial NEWS2 from kiosk vitals only).

missing_inputs.description: Fact paths still missing when partial is true, e.g. vitals.respiratory_rate.

deadline_at.description: When the required action is due, e.g. arrival + 10 min for CHEST_PAIN_ECG_10MIN.
